# Install the locked dependencies, as ci.yml does, so pi's tests.runTargeted, delivery.validate, and
      # delivery.format work on the first call instead of after a manual `npm ci` (#379).
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
      - name: Use lockfile-compatible npm
        run: npm install --global npm@12.2.0
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund

arguments.label: PR A: add Node setup and npm ci to pi-assistant workflow
